subject: PAUSED: state note (P8 shipped; 0104 CPU DVFS = WIP, host-only, not built)
body: No process of mine is running. DONE and persisted: P8 patches 0100-0103, kernels A/B, 7 images (manifest gpu/build/device-mmu-p8-candidate/manifest.json), tests-new/run_all.sh (all FINAL/XNU/MODEL PASS). IN FLIGHT (files consistent, nothing built, no images for ui654fb60cpu / ui654fb60ab yet): 0104 = gated CPU DVFS for the big clusters. Pure controller wip-0104/bsd/dev/nord2_cpufreq.h sha d94e3c76 (discover CSRAM for a cpufreq-hw domain block, verify it BY MEASUREMENT against the CPUCLK oracle, step PERF_STATE one row at a time, revert+freeze on any miss, battery-gauge start gate 40.0C / throttle 43.0C / recover 38.0C, cap 2000 MHz default, clamp to rating) and tests-new/nord2_cpufreq_test.c sha c4e47d0b (model + 120k random-SRAM fuzz + 200k mutation fuzz; the first run passed before I added the mutation fuzz; the last edit fixed a printf and was not re-run to the end: re-run needed). Still to do: kernel glue (bsd/dev/nord2_cpufreq.c, n2cpu alias, thread, weak battery hook in Nord2GPU.cpp), compile with the CI flags like compile_0099.py, kernel A' link, images ui654fb60cpu (n2fbhz=60 n2cpu=2000) and ui654fb60ab (kernel B, n2fbhz=60 n2sch=15); cmdline: base 585 + n2fbhz=60 (10) + n2cpu=2000 (11) = 606 ok; fb60ab: 585+10+9 = 604 ok. WHAT THE C6M DATA PROVES: with the dependent-add oracle, cpu0-3 measure 1791 MHz (A55, rated 2000) and cpu4-7 729-730 MHz (A78 rated 2.6/3.0 GHz, two different DVFS domains reading the same value); an A78 cannot retire a dependent add chain slower than one add per cycle, so the big cores run at about 730 MHz or less: they ARE slow, and nothing under XNU requests a frequency (reference device had the same symptom). WHAT IT DOES NOT PROVE: that a cap exists (stuck-at-boot-OPP is the simplest reading); the n2csram words (cur 2723391134/..., sched 0x7644da3b/...) decode to nonsense, so the CSRAM offsets in 0099 are wrong or the DVFS firmware is not running - the MT6893 live.dts has the legacy mt6885-dvfsp node, not cpufreq-hw; SCHED lines read 0% busy for BOTH clusters because kernel A has no scheduler hooks (level b is needed for the accounting), so placement of backboardd is UNMEASURED (stock XNU fills the lowest idle CPU number first = A55s, by source only).
